leadText:
Landis (Japanese: テルヒコ Teruhiko) is a character of the day who appeared in Not on My Watch Ya Don't!. Although he is not old enough to be a real Trainer, he does own a . He is the son of the Pokétch Co. President.

Landis first appeared when had just been tricked into taking a free fake Pokétch from . He put it under water to show that the paint smeared, meaning it was not the real thing and then took the group to the Pokétch Company.

Landis has some similarities to Max. He is young but very smart and knows a lot about Pokémon, which he studies about in the in Jubilife City. Landis also has a similar hair color to Max. He apparently likes to make Dawn angry as even after the episode was over, he said Dawn needed good luck to win the Jubilife .
